summary: Master the art of YouTube marketing with our advanced training course. Increase your reach, drive traffic, and maximize your channel's potential.
lede: YouTube marketing connects video content and channel data to defined audience or business outcomes. For channel managers, content strategists, and digital marketing specialists, the course develops practical skills to map audience intent to content, improve search metadata, and interpret reach and retention reports. It also covers planning paid video campaigns and building KPI dashboards to turn channel findings into a measurable 90-day plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage YouTube content, video distribution, audience growth, or marketing performance and need a structured route from channel activity to measurable results.
audience: Learning and Development Managers using YouTube
prerequisites: No coding or advanced video-production experience is required. You should have basic familiarity with digital marketing, social media, content publishing, or campaign reporting. A working YouTube channel, sample video brief, or recent campaign data can improve application, but you may use the provided datasets and scenarios. Advanced analytics, AI-assisted scripting, and Google Ads workflows are taught at the operational application level rather than the technical engineering level.
